apps.purpose: Worker + coordinator git identity — homelab-agents[bot] is the PR author; mints the per-repo worker tokens (agent-git-<repo>, FU-089 central) and the coordinator/loop tokens.

issues.why: queue labels, strike/report comments, coordinator C6 (composition worker gens + git-token.yaml); ALSO the sole permission of the per-stack loop-intake gens (issues-only on homelab — ADR-119 dedup-and-extend, homelab#1095)

checks.why: coordinator `gh pr checks` (git-token.yaml + composition loop-git gens; fine-grained PATs cannot read Checks — App-only)

actions.why: coordinator `gh run watch`/rerun on agent repos (loop-git gens); WRITE since FU-148 (2026-08-08) — the ci-red play's retry terminal is `gh run rerun`

workflows.why: fleet#134 — track/chassis carve-out needs workers pushing .github/workflows/ci.yaml; DECLARED 2026-07-26 ahead of the grant (the drift alert rings until the operator clicks)

apps.purpose: The review bot's identity — homelab-reviewer[bot] submits approve/request-changes. Distinct App on purpose: GitHub blocks self-approval, so it must not be the PR author.

contents.why: the approval must COUNT — GitHub only counts reviews from a repo writer (contents:read ⇒ authorAssociation NONE, ignored)

checks.why: reviewer reads CI state (composition loop-reviewer gens)

statuses.why: read: reviewer reads CI state (as checks). WRITE 2026-08-18 (G01 flip, iac-lane.md §L0b): the iac-sentinel posts its required `iac-sentinel` commit status under this identity — never the worker's own, which could pass itself

actions.why: reviewer reads run logs on private repos (loop-reviewer gens)

code_quality.why: OPERATOR RULING 2026-07-26: deliberate future-proof read — a reviewer probing a surface that 422s mid-review reads as 'something is there'; harmless reads are pre-granted so review probes fail honest-empty, not permission-denied

discussions.why: same ruling — deliberate future-proof reviewer read

issues.why: FU-069(b), granted 2026-07-16: the reviewer's SELF-GUARD breaker labels agent/error + posts the AGENT_ERROR comment on the PR — both ride the Issues API (reviewer-session.sh STEP 0). Exercised live ≥3× (oracle-fleet#39/#60, sleep-tracking#21). NOT for authoring issues — follow-ups stay bullets-in-review, filed by the coordinator lane (review.md, FU-090)

apps.purpose: The merge-serializer identity — update-pr-branch.yml's branch-update push. Dedicated App: its key sits in an org Actions secret readable by the semi-trusted CI plane, so minimal.

pull_requests.why: update-branch is a /pulls/ mutation — an App needs BOTH contents+PR write or it 403s

absent.issues: the conflict-labeling step uses GITHUB_TOKEN instead — a leaked merge key must not grant issue writes

apps.purpose: Self-hosted Renovate's identity (renovate.yaml) + devbox-update/runner-image lockfile fetches.

contents.why: renovate branches; devbox-update.sh pushes; runner-image warm-store lockfile fetch (private repos)

pull_requests.why: renovate + devbox-update PRs; runner-image self-bump PR

workflows.why: renovate bumps pinned action refs under .github/workflows/

absent.vulnerability_alerts: DECIDED — vulnerability data comes from Renovate's OSV alerts, not GitHub Dependabot (docs/renovate.md §OSV: 'we use OSV instead and ignore that warning'; self-host ethos, no repo Dependency-graph settings needed)

apps.purpose: Label-sync identity (agent label set across repos).

issues.why: create/update labels (labels ride the Issues permission)

apps.purpose: Deploy-pin bump PRs into deploy-target repos (FU-051; homelab, sleep-iac, oracle-iac).
Actions Runner Controller registers the org homelab-ephemeral scale set.
The Proxmox CI-runner VM mints its own registration tokens at boot (ADR-082).
apps.note: FU-017: merge into homelab-arc — identical grants
